purpose: Independently specify proposal or extraction, evidence support, local applicability, and host-decision behavior without using product output as expected truth.

assertion_policy.source_extraction_scope: Source producer expectations remain bound to the cited source revision and do not establish local applicability. Consumer expectations are separate analysis-run decisions.
assertion_policy.candidate_scope: Candidate producer expectations evaluate only the selected context and its declared evidence.
assertion_policy.unsupported_meaning: Available evidence is insufficient to support the proposition; unsupported does not mean false.
assertion_policy.contradicted_meaning: A distinct evidence item directly opposes the proposition and remains visible.
assertion_policy.admission_rule: Only supported plus applicable may be admitted.
assertion_policy.unavailable_rule: An unavailable proposal has support unavailable and is abstained unless deliberate deletion requires audit-only retention.
assertion_policy.deletion_rule: Deliberately deleted source material is deleted, unavailable, not-evaluated, and audit-only.
assertion_policy.explicit_abstention_rule: An explicit provider abstention is abstained, not-evaluated, not-evaluated, and abstained by the host.
